name: Ballinastraid Farm Cottage
suitableFor: Families and couples wanting a quiet self-catering stay
beachAccess: Within walking distance of White Park Bay
confirmedFeatures: Fully equipped, oil-fired central heating, private grounds
overview: A fully equipped self-catering bungalow just off Whitepark Road, in the Causeway Coast Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. It has oil-fired central heating and private grounds with safe parking and space for children to play. The listing places it within walking distance of White Park Bay, with Ballintoy and the Giant's Causeway a short drive away.
surfTripFit: Within walking distance of White Park Bay, with private parking, it suits a quiet self-catering surf break.
